SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.DATE_BUILT,
    b.BUILDING_TYPE,
    COUNT(a.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS ADDRESS_COUNT,
    AVG(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS AVG_GROSS_AREA,
    COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS r ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.DATE_BUILT,
    b.BUILDING_TYPE
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME,
       b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
       b.DATE_BUILT,
       b.BUILDING_TYPE,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a WHERE a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS ADDRESS_COUNT,
       AVG(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS AVG_GROSS_AREA,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAC_ROOMS r WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
GROUP BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.DATE_BUILT, b.BUILDING_TYPE
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME;
